omitted: support/ (historical native setup kit; receiving repository uses Nix)
reference/conaled/ (historical repository guidance; recoverable from recorded Git history)
books/**/*.log (historical compiler and environment transcripts; see log-curation.md)

log_curation.selection: Every original manifest path beginning books/ and ending .log
log_curation.path_digest_encoding: UTF-8, lexicographically sorted paths, each followed by LF
log_curation.policy: Retain useful mathematics and necessary context in source or concise notes; omit redundant execution transcripts.
log_curation.historical_references: Original receipts and reviews can refer to deliberately omitted logs. Those references describe historical evidence and do not establish current validation.
